text: Our lightweight ridge jacket is fully waterproof with a tested 5,000 mm hydrostatic head rating.

text: Our storm shells feature a revolutionary 100% chemical-free and toxin-free water repelling treatment.

text: The Northwind Lifetime Warranty covers free repairs forever, even if your dog chews the strap.
